_comment.description: A cut of 40 of CARD 4.0.2's 6451 models for tests/test_card.py. Every field scripts/prep_card.py reads is verbatim. Four that it does not read are blanked because they are boilerplate repeated per model and 90% of the bytes: the nucleotide/protein `sequence` strings, `model_description`, `param_description` and `category_aro_description`.

1.ARO_description: PDC-4 is a extended-spectrum beta-lactamase found in Pseudomonas aeruginosa.

2.ARO_description: CblA-1 beta-lactamase is a class A beta-lactamase found in Bacteroides uniformis that is species-specific.

3.model_name: Escherichia coli ompF with mutation conferring resistance to beta-lactam antibiotics

NCBI_taxonomy.NCBI_taxonomy_name: Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655

3.ARO_name: Escherichia coli ompF with mutation conferring resistance to beta-lactam antibiotics
3.ARO_description: The Escherichia coli ompF (oprF) is a nonspecific porin channel involved in the membrane translocation of small hydrophilic molecules, including and especially beta-lactam antibiotics. Mutations in ompF can decrease diffusion of antibiotics across the cellular membrane, thereby decreasing overall susceptibility through absence of porin function.

41445.category_aro_name: General Bacterial Porin with reduced permeability to beta-lactams

4.ARO_description: SHV-52 is a beta-lactamase that has been found in clinical isolates.

5.ARO_description: dfrF is a chromosome-encoded dihydrofolate reductase found in Streptococcus pyogenes.

7.ARO_description: CTX-M-130 is a beta-lactamase. Name originally from the historical Lahey list of beta-lactamases, some of which did not include sequence data.

9.ARO_description: ACT-35 is a beta-lactamase. Name originally from the historical Lahey list of beta-lactamases, some of which did not include sequence data.

16.ARO_description: KPC-10 is a beta-lactamase found in Klebsiella pneumoniae.

24.ARO_description: FusB encodes a 2-domain zinc-binding protein that binds the ribosomal translocase EF-G, causing it to dissociate from the ribosome. This action increases the ribosomal turnover rate and confers resistance to fusidic acid. This protein is considered a FusB-type protein.

43297.category_aro_name: Target protecting FusB-type protein conferring resistance to Fusidic acid

35.ARO_description: An enzyme that confers resistance to fosfomycin in Enterobacter cloacae by breaking the epoxide ring of the molecule. It depends on the cofactors Manganese (II) and Potassium and uses Glutathione (GSH) as the nucleophilic molecule.

36.model_name: Mycobacterium leprae gyrA conferring resistance to fluoroquinolones
36.ARO_name: Mycobacterium leprae gyrA conferring resistance to fluoroquinolones
36.ARO_description: Point mutation of Mycobacterium leprae gyrA resulted in the lowered affinity between fluoroquinolones and gyrA. Thus, conferring resistance.

37.ARO_description: Multidrug efflux pump in E. coli. This multidrug efflux system was originally identified as the Cmr/CmlA chloramphenicol exporter.

36003.category_aro_name: major facilitator superfamily (MFS) antibiotic efflux pump

NCBI_taxonomy.NCBI_taxonomy_name: Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. W3110

45.ARO_description: Multidrug resistance efflux pump. Could be involved in resistance to puromycin, acriflavine and tetraphenylarsonium chloride.

36003.category_aro_name: major facilitator superfamily (MFS) antibiotic efflux pump

49.ARO_description: tsnR is a 23S ribosomal RNA methyltransferase that methylates adenosine-1067 to confer resistance to thiostrepton.

48527.category_aro_name: ribosomally synthesized and post-translationally modified peptide antibiotics

55.ARO_description: OXA-69 is a beta-lactamase found in A. baumannii.

90.model_name: Staphylococcus aureus rpoB mutants conferring resistance to rifampicin
90.ARO_name: Staphylococcus aureus rpoB mutants conferring resistance to rifampicin
90.ARO_description: Point mutations that occurs in Staphylococcus aureus rpoB resulting in resistance to rifampicin.

100.model_name: Mycobacterium tuberculosis ethA with mutation conferring resistance to ethionamide
100.ARO_name: Mycobacterium tuberculosis ethA with mutation conferring resistance to ethionamide
100.ARO_description: Mycobacterium tuberculosis ethA (Rv3854c) is a mono-oxygenase enzyme which activates the antibiotic ethionamide in vivo. Mutations in ethA confer resistance to ethionamide by modulating the activation and activity of the ethionamide prodrug.

127.ARO_description: clbB is a plasmid-encoded cfr gene found in Bacillus brevis.

154.ARO_description: MgrA, also known as NorR, is a regulator for norA, norB, and tet38. It is a positive regulator for norA expression, but is a direct repressor for norB and an indirect repressor of tet38.

36003.category_aro_name: major facilitator superfamily (MFS) antibiotic efflux pump

183.ARO_description: AdeS is a sensor kinase in the AdeRS regulatory system of AdeABC. It is essential for AdeABC expression.

196.model_name: Mycobacterium tuberculosis embB with mutation conferring resistance to ethambutol
196.ARO_name: Mycobacterium tuberculosis embB with mutation conferring resistance to ethambutol
196.ARO_description: Point mutations that occur within Mycobacterium tuberculosis embB gene resulting in resistance to ethambutol.

383.model_name: Pseudomonas mutant PhoQ conferring resistance to colistin
383.ARO_name: Pseudomonas mutant PhoQ conferring resistance to colistin
383.ARO_description: Mutations in Pseudomonas aeruginosa PhoQ of the two-component PhoPQ regulatory system. Presence of mutation confers resistance to colistin.

835.ARO_description: APH(3')-Ib is a plasmid-encoded aminoglycoside phosphotransferase in E. coli.

851.model_name: Mycobacterium tuberculosis pncA mutations conferring resistance to pyrazinamide
851.ARO_name: Mycobacterium tuberculosis pncA mutations conferring resistance to pyrazinamide
851.ARO_description: pncA is a pyrazinamidase/nicotinamidase. It catalyzes the activation of pyrazinamide. Some mutation within pncA are associated with loss of enzyme activity, resulting in pyrazinamide resistance.

967.ARO_description: AAC(6')-Isa is a plasmid-encoded aminoglycoside acetyltransferase in Streptomyces albulus.

1176.model_name: Mycobacterium tuberculosis katG mutations conferring resistance to isoniazid
1176.ARO_name: Mycobacterium tuberculosis katG mutations conferring resistance to isoniazid
1176.ARO_description: katG is a catalase-peroxidase that catalyzes the activation of isoniazid. Isoniazid inhibits mycolic acid synthesis, which prevents cell wall synthesis in mycobacteria. Mutations in katG results in inability to activate isoniazid. Over 280 different mutations have been documented in PubMed for katG, with mutations to Ser315 being the most prevalent.

1469.ARO_description: Efflux protein facT confers resistance to factumycin. The gene has been heterologously expressed in S. coelicolor and its function confirmed. It is possible that this gene can export other kirromycin-like elfamycins, but this has not been tested.

36003.category_aro_name: major facilitator superfamily (MFS) antibiotic efflux pump

1474.ARO_description: MexR is the repressor of the MexRAB-OprM operon. Mutant forms of mexR result in up-regulation of efflux pump system MexAB-OprM.

1721.model_name: Mycobacterium leprae folP with mutation conferring resistance to dapsone
1721.ARO_name: Mycobacterium leprae folP with mutation conferring resistance to dapsone
1721.ARO_description: Dapsone inhibits bacterial synthesis of dihydrofolic acid by competing with with para-aminobenzoate for the active site of dihydropteroate synthetase. Point mutation within the Mycobacterium leprae folP gene results in lowered affinity of dapsone for folP.

2033.ARO_description: MtrR is a repressor of mtrCDE expression. Mutations in mtrR increase multidrug resistance.

36003.category_aro_name: major facilitator superfamily (MFS) antibiotic efflux pump

2068.model_name: Escherichia coli 16S rRNA mutation conferring resistance to edeine
2068.ARO_name: Escherichia coli 16S rRNA mutation conferring resistance to edeine
2068.ARO_description: Point mutations in the 3' minor domain of the 16S rRNA in Escherichia coli can confer resistance to edeine.

40278.category_aro_name: 16s rRNA with mutation conferring resistance to peptide antibiotics

2176.ARO_description: Homologous to vanC, contains a D-Ala-D-Ser ligase. The plasmid-located vanM gene cluster is inducible and confers low resistance to vancomycin. vanN organisms remain susceptible to teicoplanin. Gene orientation: N(XY)TRS.

2177.ARO_description: This inducible cluster confers high resistance to both vancomycin and teicoplanin by allowing restructuring of peptidoglycan precursors to end in D-Ala-D-Lac. The vanA gene cluster can be located either on plasmids or on the chromosome. Gene orientation: vanRSHAXYZ.

2201.ARO_description: PvrR is a response regulator that controls the conversion between antibiotic-resistant and antibiotic-susceptible forms of Pseudomonas aeruginosa biofilms through porin deletion/gene absence.

2261.ARO_description: lnuE encodes a lincosamide resistance gene isolated from Streptococcus suis that was truncated by an ISEnfa5-cfr-ISEnfa5 segment insertion. It shares the closest sequence similarity to lnuA.

2267.ARO_name: Escherichia coli nfsA mutations conferring resistance to nitrofurantoin
2267.ARO_description: nfsA encodes the major oxygen-insesitive nitroreductase in E. coli. The first step of resistance to nitrofurazone is mutation of nfsA.

3382.ARO_description: A novel Tn4551 streptomycin-resistance gene that was phenotypically silent in wild-type Bacteroides; expression could be activated by a trans-acting chromosomal mutation.
